dbc9447c04b88170d3fca3208a2015c42c80289e.summary: Composite thesis/CV document produces both scope overreach and whole-block misses.
false_positives: A contents-like opening list containing repeated bibliography labels is absorbed as bibliography.
CV employment, research, leadership and project-history sections contain dates, institutions and publication-like phrases that trigger large false components.
false_negatives: A conventional local bibliography at L1117–L1134 and another at L1478–L1484 are rejected as components.
Conference presentations and the author's publication list are consensus-labeled BIB but only partially recovered.
dbc9447c04b88170d3fca3208a2015c42c80289e.interpretation: The document mixes a thesis, CV and embedded paper-like chapters. It exposes a real scope problem, but also a policy ambiguity: publication and conference lists are labeled BIB even though we may not want to remove every CV section.

78ebbe15bb757d5c9e96ab209f2530c69ed5f0a1.summary: Polytonic humanities thesis confuses footnotes and an author index with bibliography while missing reference apparatus.
false_positives: Dense scholarly footnotes at L433–L463 and L3960–L3976 look like citation entries but occur in body text.
The alphabetical name index at L5327–L5362 is treated as a bibliography.
false_negatives: The abbreviations table and translated-title/reference apparatus at L4592–L4660 are missed.
The primary-works section beginning 'Gregorii Nysseni Opera' at L4670 is largely rejected.
78ebbe15bb757d5c9e96ab209f2530c69ed5f0a1.interpretation: The main failure is document-section identity: citation-shaped footnotes and indexes are accepted, while unusual but genuinely bibliographic tables and primary-source lists are vetoed.

f42ce4b7ea2fd5c2fe17253aa7b458b896047827.summary: Medical CV/publication material is inconsistently scoped.
false_positives: Professional memberships and article front matter are accepted because they contain organizations, authors and numbered affiliations.
A figure-caption/body fragment is included as a small spurious component.
false_negatives: Long oral-presentation and publication lists in the CV are missed even though consensus labels them BIB.
A REFERENCES heading and several short publication fragments are missed.
f42ce4b7ea2fd5c2fe17253aa7b458b896047827.interpretation: This is primarily a policy-boundary case rather than weak citation recognition: the silver labels treat CV publications and presentations as bibliography, while nearby CV material is non-BIB.

c71fcf4915d1c0ae61bc97a44aedf804ac96aa64.summary: A real bibliography is fragmented into Markdown-looking author headings and is conservatively rejected.
false_negatives: Dozens of entries begin with lines parsed as headings such as '## 17. Dewhurst G. J. 1957'.
Entry bodies are split across short title, journal and page lines, so valid components have weak continuity.
c71fcf4915d1c0ae61bc97a44aedf804ac96aa64.interpretation: The heading guard and component veto are too aggressive for OCR/Markdown conversions that promote numbered author lines to headings.

dab1ddd9d739dcfb199c4f0c4fcbbfdcc3957efa.summary: Several explicit, clean bibliography/publication components are rejected wholesale.
false_negatives: Two sections explicitly headed 'Bibliography' at L1672 and L1730 are mostly missed.
The later Journals and Book Chapters publication lists are also rejected despite strong citation structure.
dab1ddd9d739dcfb199c4f0c4fcbbfdcc3957efa.interpretation: This is a clear false veto by component scope or seeding, not a lack of recognizable bibliography features. Explicit positive headings need more authority in scope acceptance.

7cc8b62817111ad2197f2f65543233c4e2064355.summary: Bibliography tables and a CV publication block are missed; a contact-information block is falsely absorbed.
false_positives: Telephone, email and personal contact lines form a CV-like false component.
false_negatives: The bibliography table beginning at L1708 is largely missed.
A publication list around L3269–L3284 and several isolated bibliography headings are not connected to accepted entries.
7cc8b62817111ad2197f2f65543233c4e2064355.interpretation: The model needs better handling of table-formatted citations and a stronger distinction between CV contact metadata and publication records.

50370e28f534b9fbdc5e26aeb698d35a36f9644c.summary: URL-only webography is the dominant recall failure.
false_negatives: A long table of bare or nearly bare URLs at L2252–L2305 is rejected.
The 'Internet sources' heading, last-access note and a later publications subsection are missed.
50370e28f534b9fbdc5e26aeb698d35a36f9644c.interpretation: URL density is strong evidence inside an explicitly named webography, but weak evidence in isolation. The block model should combine the heading and collective URL pattern.

a6d586aecfda5430363d94caf774ddb10f3eabb7.summary: Most substantive references are correct; residual errors are OCR filler and two ambiguous 'Web References' lines.
false_positives: A body-prose component around a figure is overextended.
Two isolated 'Web References' lines are marked BIB by the model but not by silver.
false_negatives: Most missed lines are image markers, single-character OCR debris or page-transition filler inside silver bibliography blocks.
a6d586aecfda5430363d94caf774ddb10f3eabb7.interpretation: The line-error count overstates cleaning impact here: the candidate captures the citations, while consensus membership includes non-content filler lines inside the block.

14654d589c50bb3256740f1251e19575882ac3c4.summary: Institutional documents and heterogeneous source subsections are missed near the end of the bibliography.
false_positives: One descriptive line naming books, articles and studies is included without the surrounding source block.
false_negatives: Bibliographic and electronic-source headings are missed.
The large 'Other sources' run consists of institutional reports, memoranda and web resources with weaker author-title punctuation than ordinary references.
14654d589c50bb3256740f1251e19575882ac3c4.interpretation: The model recognizes conventional citations better than government/institutional source lists and fails to use the section hierarchy to retain them.

45807cca47b7301ba63362bd6b7599712eeda047.summary: An entire Greek-language bibliography subsection is vetoed late in a very long document.
false_negatives: The English/Greek bibliography headings at L9966–L9968 are missed.
The Greek bibliography from L10498–L10582 has OCR-spaced Greek text and is rejected almost wholesale.
45807cca47b7301ba63362bd6b7599712eeda047.interpretation: Position is favorable and the heading is explicit, so the failure points to script/OCR feature degradation or a component-scope veto rather than lack of section evidence.

e83a537f4bc563f0f56f20a6700f1f464ba250dd.summary: A textbook alternates real chapter bibliographies with examples teaching citation formatting.
false_positives: Citation examples and prose explaining how to format journal and book references are classified as bibliography.
A statistics chapter and figure-list fragments form smaller false components.
false_negatives: Multiple repeated chapter bibliographies are rejected in large 14–15-line runs.
The same core reading list appears repeatedly, but component scope does not exploit that repetition.
e83a537f4bc563f0f56f20a6700f1f464ba250dd.interpretation: This is the strongest Kallipos scope case: line appearance alone cannot distinguish a real reading list from citation-format demonstrations; chapter structure and explanatory prose are necessary.

e7abf3e1eecbc89bd0e9617272e8ace4f5423c67.summary: A compact 65-item dash-numbered bibliography is almost completely missed.
false_negatives: Book-style citations from L214–L259 are rejected as one large component.
The final URL entry is also missed.
e7abf3e1eecbc89bd0e9617272e8ace4f5423c67.interpretation: The lines have strong author/title/year/publisher evidence. This is another clear component acceptance failure rather than a line-feature failure.

07d68241cf7432da8033cbaa834c5fd5ade86031.summary: Structured exercises and metadata tables are overextended as bibliography.
false_positives: Dublin Core metadata examples contain author names, URIs and classification labels that resemble citations.
Enumerated exercises, answer choices and ordinary structured lists become several false components.
false_negatives: Only three isolated bibliography lines are missed.
07d68241cf7432da8033cbaa834c5fd5ade86031.interpretation: The problem is scope precision in a highly structured instructional book. Table/list shape plus bibliographic tokens is insufficient without a bibliography-section signal.

bebdae0b26cf94a3be9efdcec4350037bce9373c.summary: Short per-chapter reference lists using alphanumeric citation keys are entirely rejected.
false_negatives: Reference blocks use keys such as [Bis07], [Hay96] and [MRT12].
Many blocks are short and distributed throughout the textbook rather than forming one end bibliography.
bebdae0b26cf94a3be9efdcec4350037bce9373c.interpretation: The candidate is poorly adapted to local, keyed chapter bibliographies. A citation-key feature and chapter-local scope model would directly target this pattern.

false_negatives: Titles, repository names, URLs and 'last accessed' notes are split across separate short lines.
The block anchors are partly recognized, but 25 continuation/filler lines are excluded.
141624cfebf90f6d30c3426081f871ff2d8de9c9.interpretation: This is primarily a within-block continuation problem. Collective sequence evidence should retain title/URL/access-date triplets after a webography anchor.

224e6e495455a326255f424580421354197cccf3.summary: Legal footnotes are mistaken for bibliography.
false_positives: Long numbered legal notes quote statutes, cases and scholarly sources inside the body.
A small bilingual glossary/table fragment is also absorbed.
224e6e495455a326255f424580421354197cccf3.interpretation: The entry detector is doing what its local features suggest, but the section scope is wrong. Footnote/endnote structure needs an explicit negative role when the intended cleaner targets bibliography sections only.

e1a12987f5da09015c61e32411d1bb7920a8590b.summary: Ordinary pedagogical lists are mistaken for a bibliography component.
false_positives: A numbered leadership-skills list is absorbed despite being ordinary prose fragments.
Game/activity lists and a sentence with an inline parenthetical citation form smaller false components.
e1a12987f5da09015c61e32411d1bb7920a8590b.interpretation: The component model overweights list regularity and isolated bibliographic cues without enough section-level citation density.

d47b193c4a2063fd21fb65a4012eaaa65aea83eb.summary: An unheaded 14-line film-studies bibliography is missed completely.
false_negatives: The compact list contains standard author, year, title and publisher patterns but no strong nearby bibliography heading.
d47b193c4a2063fd21fb65a4012eaaa65aea83eb.interpretation: The precision-first scope layer rejects a genuine small component when heading evidence is absent. This is the direct trade-off of the current component gate.

dc5dc185840465d3f71cccbf95a8575d8c6b7c67.summary: The tail of a bibliography shifts to corporate/legal authors and loses recall.
false_negatives: UNESCO, World Bank, TRIPS and UN declarations have institutional rather than personal authors.
One Greek institutional subsection and a final web resource are also missed.
dc5dc185840465d3f71cccbf95a8575d8c6b7c67.interpretation: The line model and/or component boundary favors personal-author citation form and truncates when the bibliography changes register.

92e16ea08065a78245d0bf30c2b4efab55d32db5.summary: Two very short bibliography components are rejected.
false_negatives: Two opening recommended-book lines and an 11-line numbered end bibliography are missed.
The citations contain OCR/mojibake punctuation but otherwise recognizable author-year-title patterns.
92e16ea08065a78245d0bf30c2b4efab55d32db5.interpretation: Component size and OCR damage together push both short lists below the precision-first acceptance threshold.

09172b1ae1f4d0a0a1e267e2eb24cb6033e6c5e5.summary: A bibliography component expands into footnotes and far into the following figure appendix.
false_positives: Numbered scholarly footnotes/endnotes immediately before the bibliography are accepted as entries.
The much larger error is downward overextension from the bibliography into a figure/image appendix at L1995–L2179.
false_negatives: Eleven genuine numbered Greek bibliography entries near L1957–L1967 are skipped inside the otherwise accepted region.
09172b1ae1f4d0a0a1e267e2eb24cb6033e6c5e5.interpretation: This combines section-scope confusion with a severe lower-boundary failure. The appendix heading and image/figure sequence should be a hard stop.

8804e889b64a46798b95024eff5fcd7f1b7d3241.summary: Roughly half of an explicit Greek legal bibliography is rejected.
false_negatives: The Greek section, foreign section and case-law list are broken into several missed runs.
Short legal citations and numbered court decisions have weaker conventional title/year patterns.
8804e889b64a46798b95024eff5fcd7f1b7d3241.interpretation: The explicit bibliography headings are not strong enough to carry heterogeneous legal subsections through the component gate.

0d9bc88ee44a9cb4b62a5f450522e257399b3d80.summary: An explicit 67-line Greek legal bibliography is missed completely.
false_negatives: The block starts with '## ΒΙΒΛΙΟΓΡΑΦΙΑ / ΑΡΘΡΟΓΡΑΦΙΑ' and contains ordinary author/title/edition/publisher entries.
No part of the component is accepted.
0d9bc88ee44a9cb4b62a5f450522e257399b3d80.interpretation: This is the clearest OpenArchives scope-veto failure. A strong positive Markdown heading should prevent wholesale rejection unless there is compelling contradictory structure.

378e9f682417e1c38efa229ea9df9aa8e18f97ae.summary: Most errors are CV conference and publication lists that consensus labels as bibliography.
false_negatives: Greek and international conference communications near the front are missed.
A publication list and one later bibliography heading are also excluded.
378e9f682417e1c38efa229ea9df9aa8e18f97ae.interpretation: As with the Greek-PhD CV cases, this reveals a cleaning-policy question: silver says these publication/presentation lists are BIB, but automatic removal from a CV-like document may be undesirable.

7c048fafb9ed089cfe3cf819b7986508d77ed6f0.summary: Scattered numbered footnotes are consensus-labeled BIB but rejected by the block-oriented model.
false_negatives: Citation notes occur between prose paragraphs throughout the document rather than in a bibliography section.
Several entries span two or three OCR lines.
7c048fafb9ed089cfe3cf819b7986508d77ed6f0.interpretation: The model behavior may be preferable for the intended cleaner. The dominant disagreement is label semantics: removing body footnotes is not the same task as removing bibliography sections.

36994f1c46b463a2eea85f91a1401f99787f5db4.summary: The model crosses the bibliography boundary into an appendix and also absorbs fragmented body prose.
false_positives: A 27-line appendix/figure sequence after the bibliography is retained.
A badly fragmented body sentence with citations becomes a 13-line false component.
The bibliography heading itself is labeled non-BIB and emitted as one additional line.
36994f1c46b463a2eea85f91a1401f99787f5db4.interpretation: The appendix heading is an obvious downward hard stop. OCR fragmentation also creates artificial line-level citation density that the component model mistakes for a list.

0169eea0b47613bf6f75a9fa8f6a2025b65f996f.summary: A clean, explicit, multi-subsection bibliography is missed in full.
false_negatives: The section begins '## 7. Βιβλιογραφία' and continues through printed sources, electronic sources and dictionaries.
Mixed Greek, Spanish, English and long URL lines are all rejected as one component.
0169eea0b47613bf6f75a9fa8f6a2025b65f996f.interpretation: This is a strong counterexample to the component gate. Positive heading evidence and coherent subheadings should dominate language/style heterogeneity.

086aeb5912f40413cf1aaab61d55ecda816211e9.summary: The document is OCR-noisy; most counted errors are filler rather than citations.
false_positives: Four isolated symbol-only OCR lines are emitted.
false_negatives: A long run contains page number, single characters, image markers and then genuine bibliography headings.
Other misses are image markers and Markdown-promoted continuation fragments inside the bibliography.
086aeb5912f40413cf1aaab61d55ecda816211e9.interpretation: This document should be treated separately in model diagnosis. Its 34 line errors do not represent 34 missed or wrongly removed references; many are corrupted layout artifacts included by block-level silver membership.

400dc270a27d1f556b59f213072ff286a311a2ca.summary: A URL-only electronic bibliography is almost entirely missed.
false_negatives: The 'Electronic bibliography' heading and 29 URL/table continuation lines are rejected.
Several URLs are split across table rows or physical lines.
400dc270a27d1f556b59f213072ff286a311a2ca.interpretation: Like the Greek-PhD webography case, the heading plus repeated URL structure should define the component even when individual lines have few conventional citation features.

748975b30baf928847908da44a4650edfb331505.summary: The main bibliography is recovered; residual misses are headings and split URL continuations.
false_negatives: Sources/web-sources/book subheadings are excluded.
Long percent-encoded URLs are broken across lines and their continuation pieces fall outside predictions.
748975b30baf928847908da44a4650edfb331505.interpretation: This is a modest boundary/filler problem rather than component failure. A within-block continuation rule can fix most errors without broadening scope elsewhere.
